scan.summary: This is a maintenance service record documenting annual inspection and servicing of 14 portable fire extinguishers at the Portland facility, performed by a licensed technician in accordance with NFPA 10 (2022). All units passed inspection and are ready for use; the company must conduct monthly visual inspections of each unit and schedule the next annual maintenance by August 20, 2026, with special attention to units W-3 and L-1 which require six-year internal maintenance before November 2026.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in what this document is and what it records: it is a straightforward maintenance service record from a licensed provider, signed by a credentialed technician, with clear pass results for all 14 units. The document accurately identifies unit locations, types, sizes, manufacture dates, and next maintenance dates. The critical gap is that this record is from August 2025 and the required annual renewal date of August 20, 2026 has passed (today is September 29, 2026). This is a compliance concern—not a gap in the document itself, but an overdue maintenance deadline. I am confident in the NFPA 10 and Oregon regulatory requirements based on search results; Oregon OAR 437-002-0187 explicitly requires annual maintenance and monthly visual inspections. I cannot verify from the document itself whether monthly inspections have been logged, as those records are typically kept on the unit tags and not provided here.
